package carrier

// hold has two section citations, one wrapped onto the next line.
//
// spec: §4.7 (Claim hold and release rules,
// expiry), 4.8 (Release)
func hold() {}

// claim cites an identifier, which the ratchet does not count.
//
// spec: CLAIM-R4
func claim() {}

// text holds a string that looks like an annotation and is not one.
var text = "// spec: §9.9 (not a comment)"
